output.summary: Turnover rise is real: payroll-reconciled, so not a migration artifact. It exceeds the peer rise (47% vs peer median 38%). The monthly data show it began before ShiftWise (Oct-Feb already about 11 per month vs 7.2) and stepped up in March, when the all-branch two-Saturday policy took effect. Exit-survey schedule complaints rose from 19% to 48%, while the pay share stayed flat (58% to 61%), so pay does not explain the rise. Pay-to-market is unknown because no study exists since 2023. Manager concentration cannot be tested because the PeopleCore manager field is stale for the seven branches that changed managers, including three of the five named. Do not approve the 15% raise or the bonus withholding. Get branch-level separations, the ShiftWise comparison and the pay benchmark first.
